title: Step 6 - recall: the store from memory
intro: Write step 5's `store.go` again, from memory. Your
`Bookmark` from step 3 is already in the module.
It needs a `Store` whose zero value is ready to use,
- `Add(b Bookmark) Bookmark`, which gives `b` the next
id (1, 2, 3, ...), stores it and returns it;
- `Get(id int) (Bookmark, bool)`, false when not found;
A hidden test calls `Add` from many goroutines at once.
Press `<F6>` to submit: `go vet` and the step's hidden
tests decide. If they fail, fix it and submit again.
